top_dirs.src/main: Electron main process — CJS (.js) + ESM MCP files (.mjs). Core modules: index.js (app lifecycle, IPC socket server, tray), window-manager.js (BrowserWindow lifecycle), link-parser.js (sidebar tree builder), mcp-server.mjs (stdio MCP via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk), mcp-http.mjs (HTTP JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP embedded in Electron), frontmatter.js (YAML injection), mcp-save.js (auto-save), search-engine.js (BM25), tokenizer.js (Korean+English), git-info.js (git metadata), strings.js (i18n), preload.js (contextBridge), file-association.js (Windows .md ProgID)
top_dirs.src/renderer: Renderer UI — viewer.html/js/css (main markdown viewer), settings.html/js/css (settings editor), tab-manager.js (multi-doc tabs), sidebar-search.js (file search filter), pdf-export-ui.js (PDF export modal), image-resolver.js (local image data URI). lib/ contains vendored: marked, DOMPurify, highlight.js, mermaid
top_dirs.src/locales: i18n JSON files — ko.json, en.json, ja.json, es.json (all 4 must stay in sync)
top_dirs.test: E2E tests (Playwright): doclight.e2e.js, doclight.step19.e2e.js, mcp-http.e2e.js, sidebar-async.e2e.js. Manual scripts: test-link-tree.js, test-tokenizer.js, test-frontmatter.js, test-mcp-autosave.js, test-sidebar-tree.js, test-batch-streaming.js. Fixtures in test/fixtures/
top_dirs.docs/plan: Implementation plans per step (step17–step29) and feature branches (pivot, mcp-stability-and-packaging-improvements, bm25-search, step20–step22). Each step has phases, verification docs, integration-test-guide, final-validation.
top_dirs.docs/spec: SpecKiwi SRS source of truth. Currently has stub documents only (00.index.md with empty Active Target, 10.product-architecture.srs.md as stub, 90.appendix.md). SRS is draft/empty — no requirements defined yet.

mcp_tools_shared.description: 6 MCP tools exposed in both mcp-server.mjs (stdio) and mcp-http.mjs (HTTP). mcp-server.mjs uses @modelcontextprotocol/sdk + Zod; mcp-http.mjs uses raw HTTP JSON-RPC 2.0.

tools.name: open_markdown
tools.description: Open or upsert a named Markdown viewer window. Params: content|filePath, title, size (s/m/l/f), foreground, alwaysOnTop, windowName (upsert key), severity (info/success/warning/error), tags[], flash, progress (-1~1.0), autoCloseSeconds, project, docName, description, docType, projectPath, noSave

tools.name: update_markdown
tools.description: Update existing window by windowId. Params: windowId (required), content|filePath, title, appendMode, separator, severity, tags, flash, progress, autoCloseSeconds, project, docName, description, docType, projectPath, noSave

tools.name: close_viewer
tools.description: Close window(s). Params: windowId (optional), tag (optional). No params = close all.

tools.name: list_viewers
tools.description: List open viewer windows. Params: tag (optional filter)

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: BM25 full-text search over saved MCP documents. Params: query (required), limit, project, docType. Requires mcpAutoSave enabled.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search/list projects from saved document frontmatter. Params: query (optional), limit. Requires mcpAutoSave enabled.

ipc_actions_ndjson.description: ndjson over Named Pipe (\\.\ pipe\doculight-ipc on Windows / /tmp/doculight-ipc.sock on Unix). Request: {id, action, params}. Response: {id, result} | {id, error:{message}}

http_routes.description: HTTP MCP server embedded in Electron (mcp-http.mjs). Default port 52580. Bound port written to {userData}/mcp-port.

routes.purpose: SSE stream for server-to-client notifications (MCP Streamable HTTP spec). Required by Claude Code HTTP transport.
JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint — tools/list, tools/call, initialize, ping

electron_ipc_contextbridge.description: window.doclight contextBridge API between renderer and main. Exposed via preload.js.

ui_present.notes: Sidebar is merged link-tree + directory tree. Tab support optional (enableTabs setting, default false). Light/dark theme. i18n (ko/en/ja/es).

docs/spec: docs/spec/00.index.md (SpecKiwi SRS index — Active Target empty, Status: draft, no requirements defined)
docs/plan: docs/plan/pivot/ (6 phase docs + verification + integration + final-validation)
docs/plan/step17/ through step22/ (per-step phase plans, verifications, completion reports)
